newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit recovers on fresh fund interest overnight.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit recovers on fresh fund interest overnight.

text.p: * Ringgit recovers marginally on overnight buying vs Sing
* Seen gaining slightly on perception Malaysia trade deficit less than expected
* Interbank rates weaken as liquidity improves further from fund flows through large swap deals
The ringgit recovered slightly on overnight fund buying in London, but remained in its recent trading range, dealers said on Wednesday.
They said the ringgit was headed for further gains on a perception that the country's current account deficit would be lower-than-expected due to an improved trade balance.
"After the lower forecast for trade deficit, it makes sense to short the dollar/ringgit now," said the head of foreign exchange dealing at a Malaysian bank in Kuala Lumpur.
The ringgit was being sold down in the last few days due to, among others, a rumour that Malaysia will report a huge trade deficit of up to one billion ringgit in July.
July trade figures are expected in the next few days, though the Statistics Department declined to give a date of release.
